## 小技巧
这是一个实用建议。
:::


```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
    var reveal = document.querySelector('.reveal');
    if (reveal && window.Reveal) {
      observer.disconnect();
      // 首页（title slide）隐藏页码
      function toggleSlideNumber() {
        var num = document.querySelector('.reveal .slide-number');
        if (!num) return;
        var indices = Reveal.getIndices();
        if (indices.h === 0 && indices.v === 0) {
          num.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        } else {
          num.style.visibility = '';
        }
      }
      Reveal.on('ready', toggleSlideNumber);
      Reveal.on('slidechanged', toggleSlideNumber);
    }
  });
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
})();
</script>
```
